note: Reviewed English chrome on the Chinese pages. Each entry is a label a human looked at and accepted, with the reason. A label that is not here fails `qa/i18n-live.mjs`. `--update` re-pins the list and blanks the reasons, which is the point at which a reviewer owes one.

/components/accordion.Ingestionok: the specimen's own pipeline stages: a Badge reading `ok` beside an `Ingestion` trigger, concatenated by textContent. The trigger labels are sample data, like a chart's series names.
/components/accordion.Serving: the second pipeline stage in the same specimen.

/components/board.Backlog: a kanban column in the board's own fixture, alongside its cards (`Volatility surface 3D`, `Chord diagram`). Column names are the sample data of a board.
/components/board.Done: the third kanban column. The dictionary does carry `Done` → 已完成 for a status, but this is the fixture's column name and it travels with `Backlog` and `Doing`.

/components/overlay.Popover: an identity translation: the dictionary maps `Popover` → `Popover` on purpose, because the term is the same in both languages, like `API`. Reporting it is a false positive of the shape rule, not a missing string.

/experiences/general/publishing.Architecture: a topic chip on a sample article. The seven chips are the publication's taxonomy — fixture data, like a post's author.

/experiences/personal/academic.Dr. Rita Silva: a person's name. A name is not translated; the page declares the profile is illustrative in the frame's own header.

/experiences/personal/portfolio.The expressive one: the portfolio specimen's own hero headline — sample copy inside the simulated site, not documentation chrome.

/experiences/vertical/ai.Copilot desk: the product name of the simulated product.

/experiences/vertical/commerce.Northlight desk lamp: the product name of the simulated catalogue item.

/experiences/vertical/forum.Signal: the name of the simulated community.

/patterns/research-workspace.Momentum study — BTC-USD: the prepared dataset's own title, passed to the chart as data.
